title: Beyond Overcorrection: Evaluating Diversity in T2I Models with DIVBENCH

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from prompts with assigned and unassigned gender attributes using the DIVBENCH benchmark, classifying the gender (male, female) of the subjects in the generated images using a Vision-Language Model (Llava), and computing Precision, Recall, and F1 scores to evaluate under- and over-diversification.

Generating images from prompts with assigned and unassigned racial/cultural attributes using the DIVBENCH benchmark, classifying the race (African, East-Asian, Indian, Western) of the subjects in the generated images using a Vision-Language Model (Llava), and computing Precision, Recall, and F1 scores to evaluate under- and over-diversification.
